name: pocket-ceo
description: A CEO in your pocket for Canadian small-business owners. It learns your life from a 2-minute evening debrief, preps your meetings, drafts your follow-ups before you ask, builds new expert skills when it sees a need, and tells you the truth (roast room). Plus an accountant that calculates exact tax for your province and builds your year-end package, a 13-week cash forecast, invoice chasing, contract redlines, hiring help, receipts, inbox in your voice, a consultant built on the best business books, video editor and a daily brief. Type /start.
